photos.title: P-38 2.jpg (P-38 Lightning)

photos.author: USAF (Edwards AFB History Office gallery)
photos.date: not stated; estimated late 1942-1943 (42-12xxx P-38G serial, olive drab/neutral grey, star without bars = before mid-1943)
photos.variant: Source: 'P-38 Lightning' only. Assessment: P-38G (42-12xxx serials in this range are P-38G production); nacelle fronts show no chin intakes; exact sub-block not verified.

sun.to_sun_airframe_basis: the gondola's shadow reaches across the centre section to the right boom (about 1.6 m from a canopy 1.2 m above the wing), the right boom and the right fin's outer face are in shade and the left wing's upper surface is fully lit
